title: Diego Olivares
text:
I am a chilean sociologist, currently a DPhil student in the “Information, Communication and Social Sciences” programme at the Oxford Internet Institute, University of Oxford. I am a Clarendon Scholar, and a member of Keble College.
My research sits at the intersection of digital sociology and music studies, applying quantitative and mixed methods to examine the impact of new technologies on the music industry and musician’s labour. I have worked as a research assitant on several projects concerning the impact of new technologies in labour, and studies of popular music
